name: Interton VC 4000
description: A programmable cartridge console sold from 1978 by Interton, a German hearing-aid maker. It belongs to the '1292 Advanced Programmable Video System' family of Signetics-based consoles sold under many brands across Europe and Australia.
curiosities: Interton's main business was hearing aids.
Its software runs on the many other consoles in the 1292 APVS family, though different cartridge slots make some physically incompatible.
It uses the same Signetics 2650 CPU as the Emerson Arcadia 2001.
About 40 titles were made for it, three of which went unreleased.
